verdict.rationale: Carta is an equity-management and data SaaS, not an agent host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence covers only Carta's own MCP server and plugins for Claude, which is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story. Nothing shows Carta ships an AI assistant that connects to external MCP servers, so the axis does not apply.
